needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing with adequate visibility to enable safe crossing of this busy road intersection.
Enhance pedestrian safety by creating a suitable crossing facility at this intersection, considering the presence of shops and homes on both sides.
Install a pedestrian refuge island at this intersection to provide a safe space for pedestrians to wait when crossing busy roads with multiple lanes.
Install dropped kerbs at the intersection to enable easy wheelchair access and improve overall accessibility for pedestrians.
Increase street lighting levels at this intersection to enhance visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
